check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work

ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

pcs.pc_description: identify the manufacturer specifications and functioning of the various components/ aggregates of vehicle from the user manual and vehicle drawings
read the maintenance schedule of battery and plan for conducting the maintenance
check for any warning light on the e-rickshaw meter console for low battery before commencing the maintenance work
charge the vehicle battery at a charging station or on a 12Volt socket for 8-11 hours for a full charge, if required
monitor the overloading of E-rickshaw with luggage or passengers to avoid any power failure which may result in damaging the battery life
check and tighten the loose connections (if any) of the battery which may tend to overheat the wires, melt battery terminal, electrolyte dry-out, and it may even cut down on the lifespan of battery
ensure that the batteries are kept on rubber mats to absorb maximum vibrations otherwise it may lead to poor battery performance
ensure that electrical functions such as lights, music, etc. of e-rickshaw are turned off on exit to attain long life of battery
prepare the e-rickshaw according to nature of maintenance activities to be performed: general, mechanical or electrical job on the electric bicycle
identify and arrange the tools, consumables and spare parts required during the task
conduct visual inspection of the e-rickshaw to identify defects and indirect faults in electrical/electronic aggregate due to another system/component

perform regular servicing or repairing activities of vehicles such as tire change, checking air pressure, puncture repair, carrying out minor component repair or lubrication of parts, tightening of loose bolts, washing of vehicle etc. as per prescribed standard process
use a dry cloth to clean the battery and apply petroleum jelly only on the cable clamps and terminals
assess mechanical aggregates such as handle, axles, brakes, wheels, etc. of the e-rickshaw for any external impact/bend/incorrect fitment/wear & tear
test electrical/electronic components performance of e-rickshaw wherever applicable as per OEM SOP
perform minor repair/replacement and adjustment of components/aggregate as per the manufacturer manual and maintenance schedule
ensure that the battery clamps are always firmly tightened and fixed to their respective poles to avoid any short circuit
refill the brake oil and differential oil as per the requirement
check the performance of electric bicycle post repair
dispose of materials such as old batteries, scrap of failed parts/aggregates as per environmental policies

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: inspect and conform the vehicle’s condition as per health and safety guidelines before starting the trip
ensure the vehicle meets the legal and compliance requirements like pollution test, load limit, etc.
perform routine maintenance checks on the vehicle for tyre pressure, fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) level, working of headlights and brakes, CNG cylinder valves etc.
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, etc.
prepare a to-do list for repair requirement, if any
record all deviations observed while carrying out checks
report actual or potential defects/deviations to the senior driver/owner/service supervisor
determine roadworthiness of the vehicle and use another vehicle if the current vehicle is found unfit
confirm all gauges and warning lights are functioning properly before moving the vehicle

modules.module_title: Drive the LMV conforming to the standard driving practices

pcs.pc_description: perform pre-driving activities like shoulder checking, adjusting IRVM/ ORVM and releasing of handbrakes, etc.
insert or press the ignition key/button to start the vehicle
coordinate gear changes, if any, with appropriate use of clutch/acceleration and steering control
maneuver the vehicle safely and responsibly while regulating the speed in all weather and road conditions by coordinating the operation of all controls
use the accelerator, steering control and brakes correctly for safe driving, stopping and parking the vehicle
ensure maximum fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) efficiency while driving
follow guidelines on the road while driving like avoiding excessive honking, driving on high beam, loud music, etc.
maintain a safe distance from other vehicles
ensure the vehicle is within the prescribed speed limits at all times and avoid rod hog
ensure proper parking at appropriate spots
adhere to local and state specific driving laws and traffic regulations, including overloading
turn off ignition at red lights or after parking the vehicle to enhance fuel efficiency
monitor and respond correctly to gauges, warning lights, CNG leakage etc. while driving
ensure to stop the vehicle at a safe place in case of any malfunction and turn off the ignition
carry out a quick diagnostic check
carry out minor adjustments or temporary repairs like replacement/top-up of oil, change of tyres/wipers, etc. if possible
report the exact nature of the problem to the supervisor to get appropriate help from the command office
take the vehicle to the service point for corrective action in case of major defect or accident

pcs.pc_description: report to duty on time as per schedule
wear proper uniform and batch as per standards
use PPE kit like face masks, hand gloves, etc. at all times and ensure the same for the customer

follow proper closure procedures on completion of responsibilities for the day, e. g. park the auto rikshaw at a dedicated zone, lock the auto rickshaw, engage hand brake, close auto fare meter and app, etc.
coordinate with the customer to confirm the obtain pickup point location or other details, as applicable
inform the customer about an estimated pickup time to reduce waiting time
inform the customer in advance regarding the inability to reach the pickup point on time in case of heavy traffic jams, vehicle breakdown, road accidents etc. well in time

modules.module_title: Escalate vehicle problem to the concerned authority

pcs.pc_description: check for any fault, defect, or potential problem in the 3-wheeler
keep a record about the vehicle service schedule and coordinate with authorized person for periodic maintenance, if required
inform in advance to the concerned authority about the repair needed on the 3 wheeler for rectification of faults, if any
report the incidents, accidents or minor altercations that took place during the day, if any to the concerned authority

modules.module_title: Pick and drop the passenger safely

pcs.pc_description: to meet the customer at the pick-up point
greet the customer appropriately as per the standards
confirm the details of the customers and destination before starting the trip
take permission from the passenger to start the trip
start the fare meter and show the starting reading to the customer
assist the customer while entering and exiting the vehicle, if required
load and unload customer luggage in the vehicle, if asked
cover the overhead luggage and side entry/exit areas of the auto rickshaw with waterproof/resistant sheets in case of rainfall to avoid inconvenience to the customer
offer newspaper, magazines, or entertainment media, if available to the customers
select appropriate/fastest route considering passenger safety, the road traffic condition and distance
drive the 3-wheeler within the speed limit and without violating any traffic rules
reach the dropping point and stop the vehicle & the auto fare meter
collect the fare based on the meter reading or prior settled fare with the customer, as applicable
